name: Green Bay 2023
information: Welcome to Green Bay's biggest competition yet! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [**WCA Regulations**](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [**WCA Competition Tutorial**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook groups: [**Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473) and [**Minnesota Cubing Community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcll0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c5462feacf32808de5791361d7ec2621bbee11e5/image.png)
